title: Townsend Brown fired by the Navy, moves to Martin Vega before Skunk Works

tellings.quote:
but in 1942 the Navy fires him without
cause and mysteriously he shows up at
Martin Vega Corporation a year before
skunkworks is formed

plain: In 1942 the US Navy fired the physicist Thomas Townsend Brown without cause, and he then turned up at Martin Vega Corporation, an aircraft maker, a year before Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design shop, was formed, Michels says. He tells it himself, without naming a source, in an episode about why he believes the whistleblower David Grusch. He calls the move mysterious, hinting that Brown's work quietly passed into secret aircraft programs.
